topic: Run a real model on your own laptop
angle: One command, no account, no bill
hook: Run a real AI model on your laptop, free
caption:
Everyone assumes local AI means a server rack. It means one command and a model that fits your RAM. Here is the ladder from a laptop that struggles to one that does not, and what each rung can actually do.

🔖 Save this — the links are all free.
➡️ Follow @profit_prompts_ for the AI stack that actually pays.

#ollama #localai #aitools #opensource #freetools

slides.text: Run a real AI model on *your* laptop, free
slides.subline: One command. No account, no key, no bill

slides.text: Local means it runs on your machine, works offline, costs nothing per use, and never sends your work to anyone.

slides.title: Install Ollama
slides.body: One installer, then one command to pull a model. It handles the download, the quantisation and the serving. There is no configuration step to get wrong.

items.title: Old laptop
items.desc: Rent an hour of GPU instead

slides.caption: what inference costs once the model lives on your machine

slides.title: Where local still loses
slides.body: The hardest reasoning still belongs to the frontier models, and your battery will notice. Use local for volume, privacy and drafting. Keep one hosted key for the genuinely hard problems.

slides.text: You won't see this anywhere else
